snippet.title: Festive Themed Santa Killer Simulator – Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A short, free, chaotic Christmas game. Shoot things, move fast, nothing makes sense, again!!! Festive vibes, what are your intentions?. Not serious. Just noise and violence, again and again!! MAY THE GREEN GOD BE WITH YOU!!!!!!!!!
